turns.speaker: Ava
turns.text: Good afternoon, Meadow Pool. Ava speaking. How can I help?

turns.speaker: Tuan
turns.text: I’d like to book a beginner swimming lesson. The website mentions a Monday class, but I work late on Mondays.

turns.speaker: Ava
turns.text: We also run beginners on Thursdays. That class starts at six fifteen and lasts forty-five minutes.

turns.speaker: Tuan
turns.text: Thursday works. Do I need to bring goggles? I have a towel but my goggles are broken.

turns.speaker: Ava
turns.text: We lend goggles for the first class. Please bring a towel and a small padlock for the locker.

turns.speaker: Tuan
turns.text: Right. Is the main entrance opposite the library?

turns.speaker: Ava
turns.text: Usually, yes. Until the repairs are finished, come in through the side entrance on Birch Road.

turns.speaker: Tuan
turns.text: Can I pay on the day? I read that a single session was twelve pounds.

turns.speaker: Ava
turns.text: It is twelve pounds when you walk in, but the booking price is ten pounds if you pay online before Wednesday.

turns.speaker: Tuan
turns.text: I’ll do that. Which desk should I go to when I arrive?

turns.speaker: Ava
turns.text: Go to reception and ask for Daniel. That’s D A N I E L. Please arrive ten minutes early so he can show you the changing rooms.
